text:
emily_csm: Heads-up — NovumHealth usage just cratered. Their avg tokens/day was ~120k in Feb; last 10 days it's ~15k (~-87%). Renewal is 21 days out. Champion (Adrian) left last week and procurement is asking for a competitor bakeoff. Need quick triage and playbook.

analytics-bot: Automated alert: customer=NovumHealth, metric=total_tokens, window=14d, change=-87%, active_seats=3->1, error_rate=0.7%->3.4%, recent_deploy=2026-03-10. Dashboard: https://redwood.app/customers/novumhealth/usage

raj_sales: Ack. I had a call with their procurement yesterday — they mentioned AtlasAI has offered a pilot focusing on latency at low cost. @emily_csm do we have proof points on cost/latency we can share fast? Also do we know who the new technical contact is?

emily_csm: Procurement contact is "Maya Gomez" (maya.g@novum). Their new ML lead hasn't been assigned yet; CTO is overloaded. They said the pilot request came after a 20% SLA miss two weeks ago.

luke_eng: I can pull traces. My first suspects: (a) key rotation or env change in their integration, (b) recent model routing change on our side (we rolled a quantized variant on 3/10), or (c) onboarding churn. Can someone share a sample API request id from last 72h?

emily_csm: No API id yet. They reported "calls mostly failing" and then gave up. I can ask Maya for a trace but want to move faster on our side.

luke_eng: I'll run these checks immediately:
1) usage by API key: SELECT api_key, count(*) as calls, sum(tokens) as tokens FROM requests WHERE customer_id='novum' AND ts >= now() - interval '14 days' GROUP BY api_key ORDER BY tokens DESC;
2) error breakdown: SELECT error_code, count(*) FROM requests WHERE customer_id='novum' AND ts >= now() - interval '14 days' GROUP BY error_code;
3) model variants & rollout log: check deploys 3/05..3/12 for novum-specific routing.

analytics-bot: Query results (summary): top_key=key-abc123 (inactive after 2026-03-12), calls=78k -> 2k, errors: 429(71%), 401(10%), 5xx(19%). Noticeable 429 spike starting 2026-03-12 03:00 UTC.

olga_success_ops: Proposed immediate playbook (short window):
- Owner: @raj_sales outreach to procurement (today) with competitive counter-offer doc and cost/latency summary.
- Owner: @luke_eng technical triage + 30min deep-dive if customer can provide request ids.
- Owner: @emily_csm customer touchpoint + offer 2-week dedicated burst for the pilot (low friction).
- Ops: Check billing/seat changes this billing cycle (possible accidental downgrade).
- Docs: Send one-pager comparing our Dedicated QOS vs AtlasAI typical offering; include performance numbers.

raj_sales: I'll ping Maya now and propose a call tomorrow 9am PT. I'll attach our latency/cost one-pager and ask for request ids.

emily_csm: Also ask if they rotated API keys or changed SSO/SCIM; that would explain auth 401s. I'll prepare the email template.

luke_eng: Quick note — 429s suggest throttling from their side or our rate limits. analytics-bot results show top key went inactive after 3/12, which may be a rotated key that isn't being used. If they're trying a new key that hits a low-tier quota, that produces 429s.

analytics-bot: Additional context: dedicated routing for Novum was not enabled. Their account is on hosted plan with default rate limits: 60 rps / key.

emily_csm: Draft outreach (copy):
"Maya — saw a sharp drop in activity and some errors on our side for Novum. Would you be available for 30 min tomorrow to walk through logs? We can also enable a short dedicated burst to remove any perf differences during a pilot. If you can share a few failing request ids or confirm key rotation that'd speed things up. — Emily"

olga_success_ops: I'll spin up an internal playbook checklist in the account doc and add owners + due times. Suggested SLA: initial outreach <24h, tech triage <48h, pilot extension offer within 72h.

raj_sales: Email sent to maya.g@novum: "proposed 9am PT call, attached latency/cost one-pager, asked for failing request ids and confirmed procurement timeline." cc @emily_csm

emily_csm: Maya replied: available 9am PT. She confirms they started testing Atlas last Tuesday and that their internal security team did a key rotation on 3/12 but "might not have told the app owners." She also asked whether we can temporarily bump throughput without contract changes.

luke_eng: Given the key rotation note, priority is to confirm which key they are sending (we can match by IP and agent). I'll correlate request fingerprints and whitelist a short-term higher quota for that key if they confirm.

olga_success_ops: Action items recap:
- raj_sales: run call + signal commercial offer (due: today EOD)
- emily_csm: collect request ids from Maya during call (due: call)
- luke_eng: correlate logs + whitelist quota for test key (due: within 6h of having key)
- olga_success_ops: update account playbook + create renewal-risk flag (due: now)

emily_csm: On the call now — Maya gave two request ids: req_20260312_8f3 and req_20260313_a2b. Sending to @luke_eng now.

luke_eng: Got them. Quick triage result: req_20260312_8f3 -> 429 from our gateway because that API key was hitting a per-key 1200/min burst cap; req_20260313_a2b -> 401 (bad key). Looks like partial key rotation with new integrations failing.

raj_sales: Call summary: procurement is nervous because Atlas offered a 2-week dedicated trial with a performance SLA. Maya said price is important but reliability is the trigger. I proposed a short dedicated burst + a 30-min tech session to re-establish trust. She appreciated that and wants written confirmation on burst size and duration.

emily_csm: I'll draft the burst offer: 2-week dedicated burst (4x baseline throughput) + a technical deep-dive within 48h. If legal or billing needs paperwork, we can try a unilateral goodwill extension first and follow up with contract amendment.

olga_success_ops: I'll create a quick internal approval path and tag @finance if needed. Also adding a note to attach the SLA performance metrics we'll commit to during the burst.

raj_sales: Next steps: finalize terms and send a one-page written confirmation post-call. Emily/Luke/Olga — we should be able to close the immediate risk if we execute quickly. Please update thread as things progress. :calendar: 

emily_csm: Updating account doc and adding timeline. Will post final confirmation once finance signs off.

(later) analytics-bot: Follow-up snapshot 6h later: tokens/day recovered to 85k after temporary quota bump and key reconciliation. Error rate down to 0.6%. This thread will be archived after renewal follow-through is confirmed.
